ov: Seventeen species of slender, cat-like carnivores with spotted fur, a dark stripe down the spine and a ringed tail almost as long as the body. All are African; the common genet also lives on the Arabian coast and was brought to Spain about 1,000 years ago.
rg: Africa; the common genet also lives along the coasts of Arabia, Yemen and Oman, and in Spain, France and Italy.
df: Small mammals, lizards, birds, eggs, frogs, insects and other invertebrates, plus fruit.
fx: Genets are the only viverrids that can stand on their hind legs.
In 2014 a camera trap caught a large spotted genet riding on the backs of buffalo and a rhinoceros.
